stem: Which government action was intended to ensure that African Americans could exercise their Fifteenth Amendment rights?

options.label: A
options.text: The Supreme Court decision in Sweatt v. Painter

options.label: B
options.text: The executive order to desegregate the U.S. Army

options.label: C
options.text: The passage of the Voting Rights Act of 1965

options.label: D
options.text: The Supreme Court decision in Plessy v. Ferguson
